name: Atlantis

install_scope.notes: Atlantis supports only one installation per GitHub App.

manual_steps: Set the webhook URL to https://<your Atlantis host>/events and set a webhook secret; pass the same secret to Atlantis with --gh-webhook-secret.
Generate a private key and start Atlantis with --gh-app-id and --gh-app-key-file (add --gh-installation-id if you created the app by hand).
notes: Atlantis can also create the app itself at https://<your Atlantis host>/github-app/setup. The webhook events come from Atlantis's webhook page. Administration (v0.19.7), Members (v0.22.3) and Actions (v0.30.0) were added later: apps created earlier don't have them.
